title: SWF e2e: Ruffle oracles for multi-flag PlaceObject combos (blend+filters+cacheAsBitmap; move with blend+filters+clipActions)
description:
Test-coverage hardening identified by a read-only SWF-compiler audit (no bug found at audit time — the byte order is correct, but these flag COMBINATIONS have NO Ruffle e2e oracle, and per CLAUDE.md "byte-presence is not runtime proof" Ruffle pixel/behavior oracles are the acceptance truth; PlaceObject flag-co-occurrence field-order regressions have bitten repeatedly this session — see the resolved cases below). ADD apps/desktop/e2e Playwright + bundled-Ruffle oracle tests (follow existing patterns: mask-named-clip-1349.spec.ts, filter-pixel-oracle.spec.ts, motion-tween.spec.ts, mask-layer.spec.ts) covering currently-unpinned PlaceObject2/3 multi-flag combos.

KEY LESSON (the WHY): PlaceObject emit is split across INDEPENDENT branches that each assemble the flag set by hand — first-placement vs move (compiler/frames.ts) vs clip-depth/mask (encodePlaceObject2WithClipDepth in shapes.ts/morphshape.ts, used by sprite.ts) vs filter/blend PlaceObject3 vs the per-frame filter-tween re-emit. A flag-combination bug typically drops ONE field in ONE branch while the single-flag and other-branch tests stay green. So the oracle matrix must cross EMIT-BRANCH x FLAG-COMBO, not just enumerate permutations. Target the combos that ACTUALLY broke this session:

(1) HasClipDepth + HasName + HasClipActions — PlaceObject2, named/scripted clip on a MASK layer (THE marquee case, task 1349-2213if, done). encodePlaceObject2WithClipDepth in shapes.ts hardcoded flags 0x46 (HasCharacter 0x02 | HasMatrix 0x04 | HasClipDepth 0x40) and DROPPED HasName (0x20) + HasClipActions (0x80), emitting 0x46 instead of 0xe6 — a named/scripted MovieClip used as a mask lost its instanceName AND its onClipEvent, so _root.<name> resolved undefined and load/enterFrame never fired (Magnet.fla Scene 5 ballmask froze). Now fixed (shapes.ts L1397-1406: flags |= 0x20 if hasName, |= 0x80 if hasClipActions; field order Matrix,[Name],[ClipDepth],[ClipActions]). ORACLE: place a named + onClipEvent(load/enterFrame) clip as a mask; assert (a) swf-dump shows the PlaceObject2 flags byte = 0xe6 with all three sub-flags AND fields in spec order, AND (b) at Ruffle runtime the name resolves (_root.<name> defined) and the clip-action fires (trace-based, since onClipEvent(load)/enterFrame fire in headless Ruffle but mouseDown does not — see CLAUDE.md). Mirror for the morphshape clip-depth path and the sprite.ts symbol-internal mask path.

(2) HasFilterList + HasBlendMode — PlaceObject3 on a shape/instance (tasks 1238-1p7k9w CRITICAL and 1240-5ehpxt, both done). 1238: HasFilterList was encoded at the WRONG flags2 bit (0x10 instead of 0x01) so ALL filters were silently dropped by Ruffle. 1240: a shape carrying BOTH a filter AND a blendMode dropped the blend in the frames.ts filter-only branch ordering. frames.ts now documents flags2 = HasFilterList(0x01) | HasBlendMode(0x02) (L524). ORACLE: a shape with a filter (e.g. blur/glow) AND a non-normal blendMode placed via PlaceObject3; assert (a) swf-dump shows flags2 with BOTH 0x01 and 0x02 set (filter NOT at 0x10), AND (b) the pixel oracle shows the filter visibly rendered AND the blend visibly applied (a pixel diff vs the un-filtered/normal-blend baseline > threshold, plus a non-blank assertion). If cacheAsBitmap is added (HasCacheAsBitmap), assert no Ruffle parse error and correct render.

(3) Move + HasClipActions — PlaceObject2/3 MOVE path (frames.ts) and the sprite.ts symbol-timeline move path (tasks 1124-081c1j and 1340-17ef3m, both done). 1124: sprite.ts dropped SymbolInstance clip actions AND loopMode/firstFrame synthesis in SYMBOL timelines. 1340: a movieclip in a moving symbol froze on frame 1 (loop-control clip-action synthesis is GRAPHIC-ONLY but was wrongly applied to a movieclip on the persist+move path, synthesizing a gotoAndStop). The move branch re-assembles flags (Move | HasMatrix | HasClipActions ...) separately from first-placement; clipActionsKey/loopMode gating must hold on BOTH. ORACLE: an instance that PERSISTS and MOVES across frames carrying onClipEvent clip actions (and, separately, a movieclip imported with loopMode that must NOT get a synthesized gotoAndStop); assert (a) swf-dump shows the Move-flagged PlaceObject with HasClipActions retained on the move frame, AND (b) Ruffle runtime: the moved clip's onClipEvent(enterFrame) keeps firing after the move (trace) AND a movieclip keeps advancing its internal frames (not frozen on frame 1).

(4) Filter TWEEN — PlaceObject3 per-frame re-emit, filtersKey change-detection (task 1210-1om0ry Timeline Effects Transform+Blur, done). A tween that changes ONLY the filter (object fixed, BlurFilter ramping 0->peak->0) was suppressed by the frame-diff because posChanged did not include the filter list; filtersKey(displayObj) (frames.ts L155) now feeds posChanged + every depthState.set so a fresh PlaceObject3 is emitted each frame. ORACLE: a blur tween ramping across a span; assert (a) swf-dump shows a PlaceObject3 with HasFilterList re-emitted on the intermediate frames (not just frame 1), AND (b) the Ruffle pixel oracle shows the blur changing across frames (mid-span frame differs from start/end).

GENERAL ASSERTION CONTRACT (per task): for EACH oracle assert BOTH (i) the emitted PlaceObject flags byte / flags2 / field order via swf-dump on our OWN compiled SWF, AND (ii) the field actually TAKES EFFECT in real bundled Ruffle (name resolves, clipActions fire via trace, filter visibly renders, blend visibly applies, tween animates). Byte-presence alone is necessary but never sufficient (CLAUDE.md Verification learning; task 0663). Use autoplay:'on' + unmuteOverlay:'hidden' + hideRuffleOverlays() and the page.screenshot clip path per the visual-oracle learnings; use trace-based assertions where pixels are ambiguous (onClipEvent(load)/enterFrame, not mouseDown / Key.isDown, in headless Ruffle).

Cross emit-branch x flag-combo: scene-level (frames.ts) AND symbol-internal (sprite.ts) for combos (1) and (2). NO production code change expected — these pin already-fixed behavior. If a test reveals a real Ruffle mismatch, STOP and report it (do not patch byte logic without oracle confirmation). VERIFY: new e2e specs pass against bundled Ruffle; full ordered build + swf unit suite green (flash8-empty.fla gates may SKIP per 1207); existing e2e/golden not regressed. ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push origin/main rebase-retry. Note in docs/ which combos are now Ruffle-pinned. Concrete resolved references: 1349 (HasClipDepth+Name+ClipActions), 1238/1240 (HasFilterList+HasBlendMode flags2), 1124/1340 (Move+ClipActions / graphic-only loop synthesis), 1210 (filter-tween filtersKey).
